policy: These versions were applied historically outside the repository and are deliberately NOT committed, because they contain sensitive credential or personal-seed material: 20260731090302 embeds live Adzuna API credentials in vault.create_secret() literals, and 20260730112526 embeds a personal email address. They are attested by exact live version, recorded migration name, and SHA-256 of the live statement payload. The rest of the original 2026-08-12 cohort has since been committed to the repository and their attestations retired -- an attestation exempts a migration from the drift gate, so it must be removed once the migration is committed, or the gate HOLDs. New remote-only versions are not covered by this manifest and remain hard failures.
